authorization.human_request: Create one independent editable Blender/Godot storybook environment challenger for the current GnomiT map, while preserving the accepted gnome, gameplay and original project.

objective: Create one independent environment candidate that moves the current GnomiT map closer to the selected hybrid 2.5D storybook target. Focus on trees, grass, mine entrance, path, island mass, decoration density and scene cohesion. Preserve the accepted gnome and gameplay. Work only in Grok task-003 isolated copies.
artistic_autonomy: Grok may independently redesign environment geometry, materials, vegetation grouping, mine presentation, path construction, island shape and environment lighting within the agreed warm rounded storybook direction. Do not require owner approval for each small artistic choice.
allowed_tests: Read, decode, inspect and hash the current public GnomiT map/world sources, target references and latest accepted visual packages.
Use available Blender tools to create, edit, render and export environment-only assets inside sandbox/grok/task-003.
Create and run an isolated Godot preview only inside sandbox/grok/task-003/preview/ or sandbox/grok/task-003/game/.
Use the current 432x960 camera/framing for honest before-after comparisons.
Render identical-camera before/after frames and closeups for trees, grass and mine/path junction.
Verify editable Blender source, GLB transport and isolated Godot import when those tools are available.
Measure/check object counts, transforms, materials, pivots and asset dimensions where relevant.
Verify exact changed-file scope before commit.
After push, read back/download final published outputs and verify bytes/SHA-256.
required_deliverables: One editable Blender environment source and all actually used generators/settings/textures.
One full-frame 432x960 candidate render using the same comparison camera.
Closeups for trees, grass and mine/path junction.
GLB export when supported by the authored candidate.
Isolated Godot preview when technically possible without touching the main game.
REPORT describing observed inputs, artistic decisions, actual changes, tests, limitations and remaining issues.
PROVENANCE describing source assets, human/AI/tool involvement and known licensing gaps.
ASSET_METADATA describing dimensions, scale, pivots/materials and relevant technical properties.
MANIFEST with file sizes and SHA-256.
Verified remote delivery in the Grok branch.
Draft PR for human review if GitHub write access is available.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate is visibly closer to the chosen hybrid 2.5D storybook target while remaining original GnomiT art.
Trees use coherent large rounded masses rather than repeated identical spheres.
Grass reads as grouped natural tufts with meaningful negative space rather than distributed visual noise.
Mine entrance is a strong readable destination with convincing stone/wood masses and restrained local warm light.
Path remains the same general S-shaped navigation composition and reads as one continuous crafted structure with narrow gaps.
Island has convincing visible thickness and does not read as a thin board.
Decoration density is restrained: fewer random rocks/flowers and stronger grouped accents.
Accepted gnome identity/model/materials/rig/animation are not modified.
Gameplay, levels, progression, audio, save and UI logic are unchanged.
Blender render/concept and Godot runtime preview are labelled accurately and not confused with campaign integration.
forbidden_actions: Editing the accepted GPT/Codex gnome geometry, materials, rig, greeting animation or GLB.
Changing match-3 rules, powers, levels, goals, rewards, save/progress, audio or gameplay logic.
Editing baseline or another bot's folders.
Editing the private GnomiT repository or Cradle of Gnome.
Replacing or integrating the challenger into main/current campaign without a separate owner approval.
Changing grants, tasks, root policy, repository settings, credentials or permissions.
Merge, force-push, release publication or auto-merge by Grok.
Purchases, paid services or machine-wide installations.
Claiming visual inspection of inaccessible images or claiming Godot/Blender validation that was not actually run.
notes: Independent Grok environment challenger. The current accepted gnome remains read-only reference. A Draft PR is allowed after verified delivery; merge/integration require separate human approval.
